headline: License renewal every 5 years, fund cap raised 15%… major clash over 'casino reform plan' (comprehensive)
summary: The government's proposed casino system reform, including licence renewal every five years and a raised fund cap, is drawing opposition from casino and tourism industries. The dispute is escalating.
why: Casino operators and the tourism sector are regulated under licensing and levy regimes, so changes to renewal terms and funding obligations directly affect their costs and planning.
